targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp                                        AS timestamp,
	fire_detect_muster__value                        AS fire_detection,
	fire_door_powersupplyfail__value                 AS door_power_supply_fail,
	fire_auxiliary_system_emergencysupplyfail__value AS aux_sys_emergency_supply_fail
FROM marpower__450000_firedetection_general
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                AS timestamp,
	fire_doors_release__value AS doors_release
FROM marpower__450000_firedetection_general
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                      AS timestamp,
	fire_panel_alarms__value       AS common_alarm,
	fire_panel_faults__value       AS faults,
	fire_panel_disablements__value AS disablements,
	fire_panel_tests__value        AS tests,
	fire_panel_testbit__value      AS testbit,
	fire_panel_command__value      AS command,
	fire_panel_parameter_1__value  AS parameter1
FROM marpower__450000_firedetection_general
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                                        AS time,
	fire_detect_muster__value                        AS fire_detection,
	fire_door_powersupplyfail__value                 AS door_power_supply_fail,
	fire_auxiliary_system_emergencysupplyfail__value AS aux_sys_emergency_supply_fail,
	fire_doors_release__value                        AS doors_release
FROM marpower__450000_firedetection_general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Cabin%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Corridor%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Owner%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND (meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Lounge%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Salon%')
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Crew%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Owner%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND (
    meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Storage%' 
    OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Office%' 
    OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Galley%' 
    OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Laundry%'
  )
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Crew%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Technical'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Battery%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Technical'
  AND (
    meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Fore%' 
    OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Lazarette%' 
    OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Bilge%' 
    OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Pod%'
  )
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Technical'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Technical%'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Hatch'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (meta.description)
  meta.description,
  fire.disabled__value     AS disabled,
  fire.fault__value        AS fault,
  fire.prealarm__value     AS prealarm,
  fire.alarm__value        AS alarm,
  fire.test__value         AS test
FROM public.marpower__450000_firedetection AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta 
  ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Storage'
ORDER BY 
  meta.description, 
  fire.timestamp DESC;
